landing_faq_1_question: Ese iyi porogaramu ikora idafite interineti mu mirima yo mu cyaro?
landing_faq_1_answer: Imirimo imwe n'imwe yo mu murima ishobora gukorwa utari kuri interineti igahuzwa igihe interineti yagarutse. Isesengura ryo mu bicu (Cloud) n'amakuru yo hanze bikeneye interineti; kuboneka kwayo biterwa n'igikoresho n'uko porogaramu yashyizweho.
landing_faq_2_question: Ese nkeneye telefoni ihenze kugira ngo nkoreshe GPExts?
landing_faq_2_answer: Porogaramu y'urubuga ikora kuri burauza za telefoni. Kuboneka kwa SMS na USSD biterwa n'umutanga serivisi n'imikoranire y'ikigo; vugana n'ikigo cyawe kugira ngo umenye imiyoboro yemewe.
landing_faq_3_question: Ese GPExts ni ubuntu ku bahinzi bato?
landing_faq_3_answer: Kuboneka n'igiciro biterwa n'ikigo cyawe n'uko porogaramu yashyizweho. Reba ibisobanuro bya gahunda iriho mbere yo kwiyandikisha.
landing_faq_4_question: Ni ayahe mahingwa n'indwara z'ibimera bishyigikiwe ubu?
landing_faq_4_answer: Urutonde rw'indwara rurimo amahingwa n'ibibazo byinshi, ariko ubwiza n'ukuri kwabyo biratandukanye. Ibisubizo ni ibitekerezo, si uburwayi bwemejwe; vugana n'umuhanga w'iwanyu.
landing_faq_5_question: Ese nshobora kumva inama mu rurimi rwanjye kavukire?
landing_faq_5_answer: Ubufasha bw'indimi n'ijwi bitandukanye bitewe n'imikorere, burauza, n'umutanga serivisi. Reba amahitamo y'indimi n'amajwi aboneka muri porogaramu yawe.
landing_faq_6_question: Ni gute Abajyanama b'Ubuhinzi na za Minisiteri bakoresha GPExts?
landing_faq_6_answer: Abajyanama mu buhinzi bakoresha GPExts kuri moto n'igihe basuye imirima kugira ngo bandike abahinzi, bafate imbibi z'imirima, bandike amateka y'ibyo babonye, kandi bahuze ibikorwa byo gukumira indwara. Minisiteri n'amakoperative bakoresha urubuga rwa interineti kugira ngo barebe amakarita y'aho indwara zibasiye n'inyandiko z'imirima.
